text:
maria-ml: Heads up — customer hit a 413 on POST /v1/embeddings when they batched mixed-dimension vectors in one payload. req_id=r-9b2f
-ingest-bot: LOG: 413 request_id=r-9b2f path=/v1/embeddings size=1.2MB dims=[512,768]
sam-platform: ugh. do we want to accept mixed dims server-side (auto-split) or keep rejecting and tell clients to split?
kevin-eng: auto-splitting improves UX but adds backend fanout, routing complexity, and billing questions.
priya-product: product leaning toward server-side split for PLG ease, but only if we can guarantee predictable cost and latency.
audrey-devex: docs/SDK could offer client-side helpers to split by dim automatically. still, many customers expect server to just work. :thinking:
maria-ml: sample payload that tripped it:
```json
{
  "input": [ [0.0, /*512 floats*/], [0.0, /*768 floats*/] ]
}
```
sam-platform: proposed architecture: a small "embed-sharder" middleware that groups vectors by dim and fans out subrequests to model pools, then coalesces responses. emits telemetry for each split.
kevin-eng: must define quota semantics: bill on original payload bytes or bill after split (sum of subrequests)? billing consistency is non-negotiable.
priya-product: prefer bill on original payload to avoid surprises. also console should show when a request was auto-split and the resulting per-group cost estimate.
audrey-devex: telemetry needs: per-request dims histogram, split_count, orig_payload_bytes, forwarded_bytes_by_group, per-group latency, and number of rejected mixed-dim requests. console widgets: "Dim distribution" and "Split events" timeline.
maria-ml: security/throttling note — malicious clients could craft many tiny groups to amplify backend work. add max_splits and per-request byte cap.
kevin-eng: agree. propose: max_splits=8, max_forwarded_groups_bytes=4MB, and fail-fast with a 413 when exceeded. Also add a new metric embeddings.split_rejected_reason.
sam-platform: rollout plan suggestion: feature-flag server_split_mixed_dims; start opt-in for specific customers, then 1% canary, 10% ramp, monitor splits/error rates.
priya-product: include a product opt-in flow in the console and telemetry page. product wants an opt-out toggle per-customer for Dedicated customers.
audrey-devex: devex will write SDK helpers + sample code and update quickstarts. Also will add a console alert when a customer has >10 mixed-dim split events in 24h.
maria-ml: action items: sam will draft spec + API contract for the sharder; kevin will spec quota/billing metric changes; audrey will draft console telemetry widgets; priya will own customer opt-in messaging.
sam-platform: I'll open the PR and a canary rollout checklist.
ingest-bot: queued re-ingest test for r-9b2f with split=true -> test-run-1234
kevin-eng: adding metrics: embeddings.split_requests, embeddings.split_groups, embeddings.split_rejected, embeddings.mixed_dim_413_count.
priya-product: :thumbsup:
audrey-devex: i'll create the UX ticket and mockups.
maria-ml: thanks everyone. quick follow-up: document in the API docs that payloads MAY contain mixed dims while feature-flag is on, and that behavior is subject to quota/limits. we'll decide final policy after canary.
